patch_description:
This version replaces the slow single-point annealing population update with a deterministic differential-evolution style population search. Differential evolution changes multiple coordinates coherently, allowing it to escape configurations where one-point moves cannot improve the currently active minimum-area triangle.

The implementation retains the useful barycentric/simplex coordinate system, fixed equilateral-triangle vertices, fully vectorized triangle scoring, deterministic random seed, simplex-safe projection, and a final coordinate-level maximin polish. It also periodically refreshes poor population members around the current best layout to preserve diversity without losing the incumbent solution.
